text: The cal service aliases now load singleton module exports. CalCalendarManager imports the timezone module for its initialization side effect, and the timezone constructor sets up its zone/default-pref state. This replaces the removed service startup chain, while the Thunderbird window still sends calendar-startup-done and its window-opening consumer still waits for that topic. Module evaluation and window readiness remain distinct. This is static source evidence; startup, shutdown and native factory lookup were not run.
title: Calendar module initialization and window startup completion remain separate contracts
